q: In Philippians, Paul says he can do all things through whom?
quote: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

q: In Philippians, what did Paul say he had learned to be in every circumstance?
why: He trusted God in plenty and in need.
quote: for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.

q: In Philippians, Paul says he knows how to live humbly and also how to do what?
why: He was ready for any situation.
quote: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound.

q: In Philippians, Paul says, “Rejoice in the Lord…”
quote: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

q: In Philippians, Paul says to be anxious for nothing, but in everything to do what?
quote: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

q: In Philippians, what does Paul say will guard our hearts and minds?
quote: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds

q: In Philippians, Paul says God will supply all your what?
quote: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

q: In Philippians, complete Paul's words: “For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is…”
why: Death would bring him to Christ.
quote: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

q: In Philippians, Paul is confident God will carry the good work He began in you to what?
quote: that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion

q: In Philippians, Paul says in humility to consider others as what?
quote: but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

q: In Philippians, Paul says Christ emptied Himself, taking the form of what?
why: He was made in human likeness.
quote: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant

q: In Philippians, Paul says Christ humbled Himself and was obedient to what?
why: That is how far His humility went.
quote: He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.

q: In Philippians, Paul says at the name of Jesus every what should bow?
why: God gave Him the highest name.
quote: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow

q: In Philippians, Paul says do everything without complaining or what?
why: Shine like stars in the world.
quote: Do everything without complaining or arguing

q: In Philippians, Paul says he presses on toward the goal to win what?
quote: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.

q: In Philippians, Paul says our citizenship is where?
why: We await a Savior from there.
quote: But our citizenship is in heaven

q: In Philippians, Paul lists true, pure, lovely things and says to do what with them?
why: Fill your mind with good things.
quote: think on these things.

q: Who joined Paul in greeting the saints at Philippi in his letter?
quote: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi

q: In Philippians, Paul says he was from which tribe of Israel?
why: He was a Hebrew of Hebrews.
quote: of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews

q: In Philippians, which two women did Paul urge to agree in the Lord?
quote: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

q: In Philippians, whom did Paul call his brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier?
quote: Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier

q: In Philippians, believers from whose household sent special greetings?
quote: especially those from the household of Caesar.

q: In Philippians, Paul says who learned he was in chains for Christ?
quote: it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
